items.summary_en: A V2EX post walks through the power budget of AI data-center optics: a SemiAnalysis teardown puts the DSP inside an 800G module at nearly half its power draw, and an 18,000-GPU cluster needs roughly 46,000 modules. Two DSP-free routes are compared — LPO trims 30–50%, while CPO cuts a single 800G port from 16–17W to 4–5W. Broadcom shipped CPO switches to customers in 2024, with Nvidia's Ethernet CPO set for H2 2026. Useful for operators weighing power savings against field-replaceability.

items.summary_en: At QCon Shanghai 2026 (October 22-24), Yu Jinze, chief scientist for industrial intelligence at COSMOPlat, presents a path to turn enterprise data warehouses into shared semantic memory for multi-agent systems: the LLM only proposes writes, real data adjudicates, evidence is graded on entry, conflicts are settled by timeline checks and adversarial review, and context is built per object at use time. He reports that injecting half the semantics scored worse than injecting none, arguing such memory must be treated as a governed asset.

items.summary_zh: 本期 Java 新闻汇总覆盖 Atmosphere 4.0 GA、GraalVM 25.3（新增面向 JIT 与 Native Image 的优先内联器 SubstratePriorityInliningPhase 与安全加固）、WildFly 41 维护版以及 Jakarta Data 1.1.0 第四个里程碑等更新。OpenJDK 方面，用于加密对象 PEM 编解码的 JEP 542 在 JDK 25 至 27 三轮预览后，已提升为 JDK 28 的 Targeted。适合想一次扫完 Java 生态版本节奏的开发者。
items.summary_en: This Java roundup covers Atmosphere 4.0 reaching GA, GraalVM 25.3 with a new SubstratePriorityInliningPhase inliner for JIT and Native Image plus security hardening, a WildFly 41 maintenance release, and milestone builds of Jakarta Data 1.1.0 and Eclipse JNoSQL. On the JDK side, JEP 542 (PEM Encodings of Cryptographic Objects) is now Targeted for JDK 28 after three preview rounds in JDK 25 through 27. It's a quick way for Java developers to catch up on ecosystem releases.

items.title: Anthropic reported diary entry to police, woman faces felony charge
items.author: emptybits

items.summary_en: According to the linked report, Anthropic flagged a diary entry to police, and a woman now faces a felony charge; the quoted arrest report says Carli Michelle Heller of Bonita Springs, Florida wrote on September 26 that she would attack the Sheriff's office. The case touches on how far AI providers should go in reporting threats found in user content versus user privacy. The excerpt provided here is cut off, so see the original for the rest.

The post contains only the question title, so no timeline or background beyond the title is available here.

Only the headline is given — the article body isn't summarized here, so which conjecture, who did the work, and whether the result has been verified are all unknown.

items.description: 前言 最近编程圈最火的一个词，非 Skills 莫属。 不是指程序员的技术能力，而是指 AI 编程助手的“技能包” 。 一套让 AI 从“随缘写代码”变成“按流程交付”的标准化工作流模块。 今天这篇文
items.summary_zh: 这里的 Skills 不是指程序员的技术能力，而是 AI 编程助手的技能包，本质是把「随缘写代码」变成「按流程交付」的标准化工作流模块，文章盘点了当下编程圈最火的 10 个。适合已经在用 AI 编程助手、想给交付流程加上可复用约束的开发者。
items.summary_en: The piece rounds up ten "Skills" currently hot in programming circles — not human skills, but skill packs for AI coding assistants. Each is a standardized workflow module meant to move an assistant from ad-hoc code generation toward process-driven delivery. Useful for developers already using AI coding assistants who want reusable structure around their workflow.

items.title: DuarteSantos8/openGym
items.description: Self-hosted gym & body-weight tracker — plan routines, log workouts (supersets, warm-ups, cardio), see which muscles are trained, fatigued or detrained, import from FitNotes/Strong/Hevy, passkey login. Your data, your server.
items.author: DuarteSantos8
items.summary_zh: openGym 是一个自托管的健身与体重追踪应用，支持安排每周训练、记录每一组（含 supersets、热身和 cardio），并查看各肌群处于已训练、疲劳还是退化状态，还能从 FitNotes、Strong、Hevy 导入数据。它用 passkey 登录，数据存在自己服务器上并跨设备同步，适合在意数据归属、不想被订阅制 App 绑住的训练者。
items.summary_en: openGym is a self-hosted gym and body-weight tracker: plan your week, run guided workouts, log every set including supersets, warm-ups and cardio, and see which muscles are trained, fatigued or detrained. It imports data from FitNotes, Strong and Hevy, and uses passkey login with sync across your own devices. Best for lifters who want to own their training data rather than rent it from a subscription app.

items.title: 三年了，为什么 AI 应用还没爆发？
items.description: 最近meta讲了个算力过剩的鬼故事，AI 股市应声暴跌，大家都很焦虑。 都在问这场 AI 游戏还能不能继续，AI 应用到底什么时候爆发，AI的抖音微信小红书什么时候才出现，AI会不会重蹈 2000 年
items.summary_zh: 掘金文章从 Meta 讲的“算力过剩”故事和随之而来的 AI 股市暴跌切入，追问 AI 应用为什么迟迟不爆发、AI 版的抖音微信小红书何时出现，以及这轮热潮会不会重蹈 2000 年互联网泡沫。面向关心 AI 落地节奏和行业周期的开发者与从业者。
items.summary_en: A Juejin article starts from Meta's "compute glut" story and the resulting plunge in AI stocks to ask why AI applications still haven't taken off, when an AI-native Douyin, WeChat or Xiaohongshu will appear, and whether this cycle repeats the 2000 dot-com bust. It's written for developers and practitioners watching AI adoption timelines and industry cycles.

items.title: Claude Haiku 5.5
items.author: sfkgtbor
items.summary_zh: Claude Haiku 5.5 是一款主打速度的小模型，官方描述称它是目前最快、能力最强的 small model，面向 summarization、subagents、browser use 这类高并发任务。说明中未给出 benchmark 或价格，做 subagent 编排和浏览器自动化的团队可以拿它做对比评估。
items.summary_en: Claude Haiku 5.5 is positioned as the fastest and most capable small model yet, aimed at high-volume work such as summarization, subagents and browser use. The release note gives no benchmarks or pricing, so the claim rests on the vendor's own description. Teams running high-throughput pipelines should treat it as a candidate to test.

items.title: 被吹上天的 JWT，为什么主流网站一个都不用
items.description: 打开浏览器的开发者工具，翻一翻 github.com 的 Cookie。里面只有一条 _gh_session，一串 Rails 框架加密后的会话数据。
items.summary_zh: 文章以 github.com 为例：开发者工具里只有一条 _gh_session，是一串 Rails 框架加密后的会话数据，作者借此说明主流网站为何不把状态塞进 JWT，而继续用服务端会话 Cookie。适合正在为鉴权方案选型、想知道 JWT 在真实系统里到底卡在哪里的后端开发者。
items.summary_en: Using github.com as the example, the author notes its cookies contain just a single _gh_session value — Rails-encrypted session data — to explain why mainstream sites keep state on the server rather than packing it into a JWT. It is aimed at backend developers choosing an authentication strategy and wondering where JWTs actually fall short in production.

items.title: mattpocock/skills
items.description: Skills for Real Engineers. Straight from my .agents directory.
items.author: mattpocock
items.summary_zh: mattpocock/skills 收录了作者每日实际使用的 agent skills，目标是做「真正的工程」而不是 vibe coding。这些 skill 体积小、可组合、容易按需改造，并且不绑定特定模型；作者明确把自己和 GSD、BMAD、Spec-Kit 这类接管流程、让流程中的 bug 更难排查的做法区分开。
items.summary_en: mattpocock/skills is a collection of agent skills pulled straight from the author's own .agents directory, aimed at doing real engineering rather than vibe coding. They are deliberately small, composable and easy to adapt, and work with any model. The author positions them against approaches like GSD, BMAD and Spec-Kit, which own the process and make process bugs hard to fix.

items.title: tester-army/e2e
items.description: Next generation e2e testing framework for web and mobile apps.
items.author: tester-army
items.summary_zh: TesterArmy 开源了 e2e，一个面向 Web 与移动应用的下一代端到端测试框架，主打 AI 驱动，已在 npm 上以 `e2e` 包名发布，采用 Apache-2.0 许可。对于需要维护大量 UI 测试、又想压缩选择器与脚本维护成本的团队，值得评估一下。
items.summary_en: TesterArmy's e2e is an open-source, AI-driven end-to-end testing framework for web and mobile apps, published on npm as the `e2e` package under Apache-2.0. Teams that maintain large UI test suites and want to cut down on selector and script maintenance may want to evaluate it.

items.title: Web Search API
items.author: tosh
items.summary_zh: Hacker News 上出现的这个 Web Search API，让 AI agent 和应用通过 AI Gateway 获得联网搜索能力，背后接入了 Ceramic.ai、Exa 和 Linkup 三家搜索提供方。对想给 agent 加实时检索、又不愿逐个对接搜索厂商的开发者来说，网关式聚合省掉了不少集成工作。
items.summary_en: A Web Search API posted on Hacker News lets AI agents and applications search the web through an AI Gateway, with Ceramic.ai, Exa and Linkup as the underlying providers. That aggregation is useful for developers who want live retrieval inside their agents without integrating each search vendor separately.

items.title: 一杯等90分钟，凌晨1点还没散！广东跑出一批“老式爆店”

items.description: 不是恰饭，也不是踩一捧一。只是记录一个 Codex 老用户切换到 WorkBuddy 的真实一周，以及过程中踩到的坑和省下的钱。 一、为什么换：被逼无奈的"搬家" 很早就听说腾讯出了智能体编程工具 W
items.summary_zh: 一位 Codex 老用户记录了自己切换到腾讯智能体编程工具 WorkBuddy 一周的真实体验，包括过程中踩到的坑和省下的钱，并强调既非恰饭也不踩一捧一。对于正在纠结 AI 编程工具选型、关心迁移成本与实际开销的开发者，这类一线对比比官方宣传更有参考价值。

items.title: Tell HN: GitHub refuses to remove cracked copies of my software after a month
items.author: IvanK_net

items.summary_en: The developer of Photopea describes how people use AI to scrape his site's JavaScript, strip the ads, and publish the result on GitHub as a "new product" — he counts tens of such repositories. He filed a DMCA notice on September 4, and a month later GitHub replied that it could not confirm a violation of 17 U.S. Code § 1201; he is now asking whether to hire a lawyer.

items.title: Opus 5.5 agents discover two room-temperature magnetic semiconductor candidates
items.author: outlier99
items.summary_zh: 一队 Claude Opus 5.5 agents 找到两种候选磁性半导体，据称面向下一代计算机内存，两者都被预测净磁性为零、却仍能按自旋区分电子：一种是新设计的化合物，另一种是 1999 年首次合成的材料。原文摘录到这里中断，没有提及实验验证或论文。

items.title: Shipping JPEG XL in Chrome

Only those format-level benefits are spelled out here, with no shipping timeline.
